theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_scsp_tf_rotation_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e v w : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (t : ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ ![v, w] → Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range ![v, w]) = Q → DifferentiableAt ℝ g (t • v) → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (Q.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => g y • (inner ℝ y u • e - inner ℝ y e • u)) (t • v)).toLinearMap) = fderiv ℝ g (t • v) w * (t * (inner ℝ v u * inner ℝ w e - inner ℝ v e * inner ℝ w u))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
